The '''Raspar system''' was located in the [[Tragan Cluster/Legends|Tragan Cluster]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Raspar [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-5.<ref name="TEA" /> The name of the system built upon the mention of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Raspar-6]] in the [[1993]] book ''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]'', a publication that combines creature designs and photographs from various projects of [[George Lucas]], creator of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' franchise, with original text by [[Bob Carrau]].<ref name="Monsters">''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]''</ref>

In ''Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas'', Raspar-6 is described as a terrestrial moon on which an [[Atomic blast on Raspar-6|atomic blast]] erupted at some point. A subsequent weather forecast&mdash;which referred to Raspar-6 as a "delinquent moon"&mdash;for the [[West Fissure]] region of an [[Unidentified planet (West Fissure)|agricultural planet]] prognosticated that the explosion would affect the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], potentially causing [[Unidentified calendar (Raspar system)|months]]-long climate changes in the West Fissure area.<ref name="Monsters" /> [[Lucasfilm]] employee [[Leland Chee]], who maintains the [[Holocron continuity database]], has indicated that information contained in ''Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas'' is [[Canon|non-canonical]]<ref name="Chee">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=690#14724917|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-05-03|time=5:45 PM|quote=And is information from Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas canon? Unless referred to by a source that is in-continuity, the information is non-continuity.}}</ref> with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Legends">{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}}</ref>
